newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VNU SHARES BACK UP AS IT EXITS BID RACE.
newsitem.headline: VNU SHARES BACK UP AS IT EXITS BID RACE.

text.p: Shares in Dutch publisher NV Verenigd Bezit VNU recovered from an earlier sell-off to stand almost 3.5 percent higher at the midsession.
VNU earlier said it would not launch a counter offer for British exhibitions organiser Blenheim Group Plc and that it was open to offers for its 15 percent stake.

The shares, which dipped two percent on news that United News and Media Plc had bid for Blenheim and snapped up 51 percent of its shares, were at 32.50 guilders at 1025 GMT, up 0.90 from the previous close.
